request.label: outlet-campaign-cp2-bx3-publish
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$1"
archive='evidence/outlet-campaign-cp2-bx3.tar.gz'
test ! -e "$archive"
for item in 'evidence/outlet-Bx3-audit.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bx3-audit-inlet.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-Bx3-Bf.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bx3-admission-1.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-bx3-direction-probe.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-bh1-design.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bh1-forecast.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-admission/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-admission-1/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-audit/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-compare/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-1-inputs/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-1-steady/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-2-inputs/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-2-steady/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-3-inputs/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-3-steady/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-inputs/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-steady/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bx3-direction-probe/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bh1-forecast/receipt.json'; do test -f "$item"; done
temporary="$archive.work-$$"
trap 'rm -f -- "$temporary"' EXIT
tar -I 'gzip -1' -cf "$temporary" 'evidence/outlet-Bx3-audit.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bx3-audit-inlet.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-Bx3-Bf.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bx3-admission-1.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-bx3-direction-probe.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-bh1-design.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bh1-forecast.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-admission' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-admission-1' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-audit' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-compare' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-1-inputs' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-1-steady' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-2-inputs' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-2-steady' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-3-inputs' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-continue-3-steady' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-inputs' 'operations/outlet-qual-bx3-steady' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bx3-direction-probe' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bh1-forecast' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bx3-iterate.sh' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bx3-iterate.log' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bx3-iterate.exit' 'tools/outlet-python-v39/h27/task2_outlet_campaign.py' 'tools/outlet-python-v39/h27/task2_outlet_direction_probe.py' 'tools/outlet-python-v39/h27/task2_outlet_interface.py' 'accounting.json'
tar -tzf "$temporary" >/dev/null
mv -- "$temporary" "$archive"
stat -c '%n %s' "$archive"
